texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreetin: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\pNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\lTRAINERS battle.$
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_ChallengeVisi: A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is\nvisiting my home.\pWould you like to challenge\n{STR_VAR_1}?$
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_YouWontBattle: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle…$
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3: Oh, good, good!\pBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\pCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?$
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_SaveYourProgr: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.$
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_HopeToSeeAGoo: I hope to see a good match!$
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie: So, it became a standoff.\pIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!$
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon: That was superlative!\pWhy, it was like seeing myself in\nmy youth again!$
texts.RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost: Ah, too bad for you!\pBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.$
